unsupported_output_formats.geoparquet: Normal GeoPackage conversion currently casts native DBF dates to strings. Source adapter supplies a separately verified native date32 GeoParquet; normal regeneration is quarantined until a mapping is approved.

unsupported_output_formats.shapefile_zip: The full original producer archive is retained in raw/. Regenerated DBF loses the proposed explicit original source FID or renames it; no regenerated mapping approval.
